floor.prompt: Create a FOREST FLOOR terrain texture for an old-school pixel-art fantasy hex-map game. Reference1 is the existing forest tile style; reference2 is grass ground style. REMOVE all tall trees, tree trunks and overhead tree canopies. Keep only dense mossy dark-green earth, low grass and tiny ferns, scattered small gray pebbles, subtle fallen leaves, with center somewhat clear. Same tiny crisp hand-pixelled detail, colors, overhead oblique camera and understated light as the references, not glossy, not painted realism. Full opaque square, intended140x140, fills edges, no hex outline, border, text, sky or tall objects. This is the lower ground layer under separate tree sprites, so do not include tree stumps or oversized roots. Match original forest's deep green mood and texture closely.

trees.prompt: Create ONE transparent-background FOREST TREE CLUSTER sprite to overlay an existing old-school fantasy pixel-art hex terrain tile. Use reference forest image to match exact tiny dense hand-pixelled foliage/trunk style, vibrant leafy green mottled crowns, warm brown trunks and small roots, fixed elevated oblique game camera, upper-left daylight. Three complete small deciduous trees grouped naturally: taller back-center tree, medium left and right trees; entire crowns and every branch included with margin, no chopped tops or sides. Broad irregular leafy rounded crowns (not pine trees). Final intended sprite140 pixels wide by180 pixels tall, all roots near the lower portion, crowns in upper portion; trunks slimmer than canopies. Put roots/trunk feet in a compact footprint centered below, leave some see-through gaps so underlying ground remains visible. TRANSPARENT background including all gaps, no solid ground patch, grass lawn, sky, rectangle, hexagon, floating pedestal, text, border or cast shadow rectangle. No huge rock/extra object. Style and perspective must look like extracted/completed trees from the reference rather than modern glossy/cartoon/photoreal art. Crisp low-resolution readable pixel texture, do not make a sheet of variants. Single tree cluster only, three trees as one decoration.
